description: The entity does not use detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities and susceptibilities to newly discovered vulnerabilities.

metadata.detection_notes: Review vulnerability scanning processes, patch management procedures, configuration monitoring tools, and vulnerability assessment reports. Verify regular vulnerability scans and remediation tracking.
